grammar.label: get somebody to do; persuade somebody to do

explanation.en: 'Get somebody to do' means persuade them. Compare 'make somebody do' (force, no 'to') and 'let somebody do' (allow, no 'to').
explanation.uz: 'get somebody to do' — ko'ndirmoq. 'make somebody do' — majburlamoq ('to' yo'q); 'let somebody do' — ruxsat bermoq ('to' yo'q).

grammar.positive_example: I got my brother to help me with the form.
grammar.negative_example: I got my brother help me with the form.

l1_notes.uz: 'to' qo'shiladimi yoki yo'qmi — fe'lga bog'liq; yodlash kerak.

grammar.label: relative clauses with prepositions
grammar.form: the person I spoke to; the person to whom I spoke
grammar.meaning: a relative clause whose verb needs a preposition

explanation.en: In speech the preposition stays at the end: 'the man I worked with'. In formal writing it moves in front of whom or which: 'the man with whom I worked.'
explanation.uz: Og'zaki nutqda predlog oxirida qoladi: 'the man I worked with'. Rasmiy yozuvda esa whom/which oldiga ko'chadi: 'the man with whom I worked.'

grammar.positive_example: That is the colleague I share an office with.
grammar.negative_example: That is the colleague with who I share an office.

l1_notes.uz: Predlogni ikki marta qo'yish ('the house which I live in it') o'zbekcha tuzilishdan kelib chiqadi.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: Aziz, could you take this one? It is a customer I have worked with before.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: The one you were complaining about?

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: The same. He is the man I spoke to on Friday.

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: He wants a lower price. I got my manager to agree to five per cent.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: And if he asks for ten?

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: Then say no. Do not let him persuade you to go further.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Is there anybody I can ask if it gets difficult?

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: Dilnoza. She is the colleague I share an office with.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: And if I get it wrong?

body.speaker: Sarah
body.text: Then we fix it. I asked you to take it because you are careful.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: I will call him now, before I lose my courage.
